title: Inventory Control Center
lead: Stock, locations, counts, discrepancies and approvals in one place. Every balance change is a ledger movement; nothing is edited in place.

scope.countryHint: Change the country from the working context at the top of the app.

state.notSetUpBody: The database part of this section has not been installed for your company. Nothing is shown until it is, so no figure on this screen is invented.
state.deniedTitle: You do not have access to this
state.deniedBody: This needs the "{cap}" permission for inventory. Ask an administrator if you need it.
state.truncated: Showing the first 20,000 lines only. Narrow the site or country to see everything.

overview.naHint: N/A means the figure cannot be measured yet (the part is not set up, or the data is missing). It never means zero.
overview.rulesSub: Rules enforced by the database, not only by this screen

rules.noNegative: Physical stock can never go below zero. Shortages and backorders are recorded separately.
rules.blind: Counts are blind: the counter never sees how many the system expects.
rules.segregation: The person who counted cannot approve the adjustment.
rules.ledger: The ledger is append-only. Mistakes are corrected by a reversal, never by editing.
rules.erp: Financial postings stay in the ERP. Inventory creates no accounting entries.
rules.tyres: Each tyre has one custody state. Conflicts are investigated, never corrected automatically.
rules.currency: Values are shown per currency (SAR, AED, EGP) and never added together.

locations.title: Location hierarchy
locations.name: Name
locations.empty: No locations yet. Add a warehouse, then its zones and bins.
locations.readOnly: You can view locations. Adding or changing them needs the transfer permission.
locations.labelSheetSub: Each label carries TP:LOC and the location id. Scan it on the phone to open that bin.

errors.codeFormat: Use letters, numbers, dot, dash or underscore (up to 40).
errors.codeTaken: This code is already used at this site.
errors.name: Enter a name.
errors.selfParent: A location cannot be inside itself.

movements.appendOnly: The ledger is append-only. A wrong movement is corrected by a reversal that points back to it.
movements.reverseBody: A new movement will cancel this one. The original stays in the ledger. A reason is required.
movements.reasonRequired: Enter a reason for the reversal.

audits.mine: Only audits I am part of
audits.newSub: The counter will count blind. The reviewer and approver must be different people from the counter.
audits.howItWorks: Start takes a snapshot of the expected stock. The counter counts blind, the reviewer reconciles, lines outside tolerance are recounted by someone else, then an approver decides each adjustment.
audits.noSnapshot: Not taken yet (taken when the audit starts)
audits.counterNote: You are the counter. You will not see expected quantities, and you cannot approve this audit's adjustments.
audits.noActions: There is nothing for you to do on this audit right now.

errors.sameReviewer: The reviewer must be a different person from the counter.
errors.duePast: The due date cannot be in the past.

count.blindBody: Count what is physically there. Expected quantities are hidden on purpose. Leave a line blank if you did not count it; tick Confirmed zero if the shelf is empty.
count.noLines: No lines were assigned to you for this audit.
count.extrasTitle: Found items not on the list
count.extrasBody: Add anything on the shelf that is not on your list. The reviewer will see it as unexpected.
count.confirmBody: After you submit you cannot change these figures. A recount, if needed, is done by someone else.
count.badQty: A counted quantity must be a number of zero or more.
count.badExtra: Each extra item needs a quantity above zero.
count.nothing: Enter at least one counted line before submitting.
count.extraItemUnknown: No item with this code was found. Check the code or label.
count.extraItemAmbiguous: More than one item uses this code. Use the barcode or ask the reviewer.
count.extraLocationUnknown: This location code is not part of this audit.
count.extraLocationAmbiguous: More than one location in this audit uses this code.
count.extraUnresolved: Some found items could not be matched. Correct the marked lines; nothing was sent.
count.partialRejected: {done} lines were saved. {rejected} lines were not accepted; they stay below with the reason. Correct them and submit again.

recon.netAbsHint: Net can hide offsetting losses, so the absolute variance is always shown beside it.
recon.noLines: No snapshot or count lines yet.
recon.recountBody: Assign a recount to a different person. Serial-tracked tyres have zero tolerance.

approve.noCapability: You do not have the adjustment approval permission.
approve.segregation: You counted, recounted or created this, so someone else must approve it.

disc.approvalSteps: Step 1: ask for approval of this adjustment. Step 2: another person decides it in Controls > Approvals. Step 3: post it below; the database refuses a post that was not approved or that changed after approval.
disc.recountSteps: A recount needs an approved request naming the recounter first. Request it, let another person approve it, then assign the same person.
disc.noAdjustmentYet: No adjustment has been raised for this discrepancy yet, so there is nothing to send for approval.
disc.recountBody: A recount is done by a named person who has not counted these lines. It is assigned here, not approved.
disc.readOnly: You can read this investigation. Changing it needs the discrepancy review permission.
disc.correctionPreview: Stock change on approval: {change} (book quantity at the count: {expected}).
disc.notProposed: Approval opens once a correction has been proposed.
disc.noteRequired: A note is required to reject or hold.

controls.permTitle: What you can do in inventory
controls.permSub: Based on your role and any personal grants
controls.serverNote: This list decides what the screen offers. The database checks every action again, so a refusal can still appear.
controls.noAutoMerge: Items that look like duplicates are reviewed one by one. Nothing is merged automatically.

opening.approvalFirst: Approving this batch needs an approved request from someone other than the preparer. Request it, let another person decide it in Controls > Approvals, then approve the batch.
opening.rule: Existing stock figures are not assumed correct. Load an opening balance as a batch: map the columns, check missing costs, submit, then someone else approves it.
opening.readFailed: The file could not be read.
opening.previewNote: Showing the first {shown} of {total} lines. All lines are saved in the batch.
opening.notSubmitted: Only a submitted batch can be approved.

issue.bad_cost: Cost is not a valid number

links.materialIssueSub: Issue and return against job cards

supply.erpRule: Orders are tracked here for stock planning. Invoices and accounting postings stay in the ERP.
supply.receiveRule: A goods receipt adds stock through a receipt movement. Rejected quantities never enter on-hand stock.
supply.grnLinesSub: Received, accepted and rejected per line
supply.consignmentRule: Consignment and supplier-owned stock is counted but is not your stock value. Cost reaches the books only through the ERP.

inv.choose: Choose a Tyre or PMV engineer
inv.noCandidates: No approved user holds a Tyre or PMV Engineering role. Give one person that role in Console, Users first.
inv.needFinding: Record at least one finding before proposing a correction.
inv.proposeRule: Proposing sends an approval request to an independent PMV Manager. You cannot approve your own proposal. Tyre records are not changed from here.
inv.waiting: Waiting for an independent PMV Manager to approve or reject the proposal.

tyres.syncHint: Re-reads tyre records and scrap marks. Tyre records are never changed.
tyres.decisionRule: This records your decision on the conflict only. Tyre records and scrap marks are not changed from here.
tyres.investigationRule: A scrapped but active tyre is investigated, not decided here: a Tyre or PMV engineer is assigned, records findings and proposes a correction, an independent PMV Manager approves it, and the case is closed as a decision. The tyre team then applies the correction in tyre records.
tyres.rule: Each tyre has exactly one custody state, derived from tyre records without changing them. Time in stock is not running life, so no km or life is shown here.
tyres.conflictsSub: Tyres whose records disagree, for example scrapped yet still fitted
tyres.search: Search serial, asset, brand or size
tyres.noAutoFix: This is not corrected automatically. An authorised person decides, with this evidence, which record is right.
tyres.noEvidence: No evidence was attached to this conflict.

ident.lookupSub: Scan or type a bin label, item code, barcode or cross-reference
ident.partial: Some lookups are not set up yet, so results may be incomplete.
ident.nothing: Nothing in inventory matches this code.
ident.labelsSub: Print QR labels for bins and assets
ident.compatSub: OEM references and fitments approved by engineering
ident.noCompatBody: No approved OEM reference or fitment exists yet, so no part is suggested as compatible. Nothing is matched by description.
ident.compatNotSetUp: The compatibility tables are not set up yet.

valuation.pendingAllocation: {qty} units left a balance that held both known and unknown cost, so how many were at known cost is undecided. They are counted on their own, never as valued or as zero, and the valuation stays incomplete until the split is decided in Cost reconciliation.
valuation.incompleteNote: Some owned stock has no known cost. The amount shown is the valued part only, not the total. Reconcile the missing costs to complete it.
valuation.fromBalances: The valuation view is not installed yet, so these figures are worked out from the balance lines.
valuation.byCurrencySub: Each currency on its own; currencies are never added together.
valuation.mixed: Values are listed per currency. They are never added together.
valuation.unvaluedNote: {n} lines have no cost. They are counted as unvalued, not as zero.
valuation.method: Weighted average cost per item, calculated by the database. Serialised tyres keep their own purchase price. This value is never added to the ERP expense figures and creates no posting.
valuation.bySiteSub: Every stock line with its valued and unvalued quantity. Only owned stock counts in the totals above.

sim.title: Investment and stocking-strategy scenario
sim.sub: Compare buying in bulk, holding stock, supplier-managed stock, consignment or a framework price, over the same demand
sim.label: Scenario (modelled, not an actual saving). Every value you type is an assumption.
sim.missing: Enter the required inputs to model both strategies: {fields}.
sim.incomplete: Both strategies need the same currency and their required inputs.
sim.notSaving: A positive difference means the alternative costs less in the model under these inputs. Working capital released is cash not tied up in owned stock; neither figure is an actual saving.

planning.replenishmentSub: Suggested order quantities from actual usage
planning.signalsSub: Available stock (on hand minus reserved) against the reorder point set for the line
planning.noSignals: No line is at or below its reorder point.
planning.simNoData: Brand-change and part-substitution scenarios need validated compatibility. None exists yet, so no scenario is offered.
planning.simReady: {n} validated compatibility records are available for scenarios.
planning.simHonesty: Scenarios are hypothetical and are never shown as actual savings.

reports.title: Inventory reports
reports.sub: Each file carries a report reference, its filters and the snapshot time
reports.notSetUp: This report's data is not set up yet.
reports.currencyRule: Money columns always sit beside their currency. Totals across currencies are never calculated.

approvals.rule: Adjustment posting, opening balance approval, recount assignment and cost reconciliation each need an approved request first. Ask for approval where the evidence is; another person decides it here; then the posting step applies exactly what was approved. The database decides who may decide and says why when you cannot.
approvals.queueSub: Requests waiting for a decision. Decide is offered only when the database says you may.
approvals.requested: Approval requested. It now appears in the approvals queue.
approvals.alreadyRequested: This approval was already requested; nothing new was sent.
approvals.decideRule: You cannot approve your own request or a record you counted, prepared or proposed. A rejection needs a reason.
approvals.rejectNeedsNote: A rejection needs a reason in the note.

costRecon.splitHint: The rest of the units stay at unknown cost and get their own cost reconciliation. Give evidence or a reason.
costRecon.decidedSplit: Decided: {valued} at known cost, {unvalued} at unknown cost.
costRecon.heldElsewhere: The undecided units travelled with a transfer; the split also settles the receiving balance.
costRecon.snapshotUnvalued: Balance at unknown cost before the movement
costRecon.snapshotValued: Balance at known cost before the movement
costRecon.allocationRule: These units left a balance that held both known and unknown cost. Nothing assumed which units went. Decide from evidence (batch, receipt, GRN) how many were at known cost. A split cannot be written off.
costRecon.title: Cost reconciliations
costRecon.rule: Stock that moved without a known cost is listed here. Unknown cost becomes known only through these three steps: propose the evidenced cost (or a write-off), another person approves it, then post it. A cost is never assumed and never zero.
costRecon.empty: No cost reconciliation for this filter.

kinds.issue_allocation: Split undecided on a mixed balance

costRecon.readOnly: You can see this reconciliation but not propose a cost.
costRecon.closedNote: This reconciliation is closed. Nothing more can be posted on it.
costRecon.consumedNote: These units were already issued. The approved cost is recorded for them; it does not change the stock still on hand.
costRecon.creatorNote: You raised this record, so you cannot post its resolution. Someone else must post it after approval.
costRecon.step2Body: Another person decides the proposal in Controls > Approvals. The status above shows where it stands.
costRecon.source: Reason or source of the cost
costRecon.noZero: A blank cost is refused rather than sent as zero. A cost of zero is accepted only with evidence, for example a free-of-charge delivery note.
costRecon.needsFinancialPost: Posting needs the financial posting permission.

erp.title: ERP reconciliation
erp.rule: Read-only comparison of inventory issues with the ERP issue lines, per month, site, item and currency. Nothing here posts to the ERP or changes stock; differences are investigated, not auto-corrected. Matching is by item code text.
erp.empty: No reconciliation lines for these filters.

flows.movedPendingNote: The undecided part is recorded for a person to decide from evidence; no value was assumed for it.
flows.movedSplit: Moved at known cost: {valued}. Moved at unknown cost: {unvalued}. Split undecided: {pending}.
flows.movedUnvaluedNote: The part at unknown cost has an open cost reconciliation; the value moved covers the known part only.
flows.replayed: Already posted with this request; nothing was posted twice.
flows.shortageBody: Stock cannot go negative. Nothing was posted and a shortage exception was recorded for follow-up.
flows.receiveSub: Accepted quantity enters stock at the location; rejected quantity never does.
flows.itemSearch: Type 2+ characters of the item code
flows.stockSearch: Type 2+ characters of the item code
flows.blankCost: Leave the cost blank when it is not known: the stock is kept as unvalued, never priced at zero.
flows.reserveIssueSub: Hold stock for a job card, then issue it. Reserved stock stays on hand until issued.
flows.sourceReceiptAuto: Not named (only allowed when the item is not serial or lot tracked)
flows.sourceReceiptHint: For a serial or lot tracked item whose stock mixes known and unknown cost, choose the receipt the units came from.
flows.noNegative: Stock never goes negative. A request larger than the available quantity is refused and recorded.
flows.transferRule: A transfer moves stock to an in-transit location on dispatch and into the destination when it is received. A short receipt stays in transit until it is received or returned.
flows.dispatchSub: Choose the two locations and the stock lines to send.
flows.receiveTransferSub: Enter what actually arrived. Anything not received stays in transit.
